direct dispatcher calls to all 11 recovered byte-accessor caller functions and both identification handlers
configured UID-zero service and App::projection execute label
19 recovered labels with bilateral write rules required by Linux 4.1 Smack UDS stream-connect checks
37 exact direct first-party event producers using offset-64 marshaling and total used-size framing

partial_reads.impact_boundary: short-read realization, allocator effects, and any attacker-visible use of uninitialized bytes are not demonstrated
partial_reads.mechanism: both receivers treat positive short MSG_WAITALL reads as success; a short header leaves unread stack fields, potentially including declared total, in use, while a short body leaves an uninitialized malloc tail inside the declared allocation before dispatch

resource_use.impact_boundary: memory availability, process/supervisor behavior, and user-visible denial of service are unknown
resource_use.mechanism: the uint32 declared total has no reviewed maximum before malloc and a blocking MSG_WAITALL body receive

transaction_remaining.impact_boundary: a specific downstream disclosure, crash, code execution, physical phone route, or CVE identity is not demonstrated
transaction_remaining.mechanism: the field proven by producers and receivers to be total size is reused as payload remaining after the parse pointer advances by 64, allowing marshal accessors to accept reads extending by as much as 64 bytes past the transaction allocation

undersized_total.classification: exact-static local AF_UNIX heap out-of-bounds write candidate (CWE-787)
undersized_total.impact_boundary: allocation behavior, allocator corruption, process crash, code execution, SMACK-domain transition, root, persistence, and installed-unit applicability are not demonstrated
undersized_total.mechanism: a connected client can supply a declared total below 64; the UID-zero App::projection server allocates that smaller size and performs eight fixed qword header stores before its lower-bound branch

framework_client_receiver: uses the same uncleared-stack 64-byte MSG_WAITALL header read and positive-only return check
may consume an unreceived declared-total field, then allocates exactly that value, copies 64 bytes before the lower-bound branch, and dispatches server events

marshal_length_semantics.consumer: iAp2MarshalInitFromTxn starts parsing at transaction+0x40 but copies the total-size field directly into remaining without subtracting 0x40
marshal_length_semantics.producer: all 37 recovered direct SendEventToApp producers initialize marshaling at offset 0x40 and store iAp2MarshalGetUsedSize at header offset 0x38; successful ordinary marshals therefore encode total transaction size including the 64-byte header

service_server_receiver: receives a nominal 64-byte header into an uncleared stack object but accepts any positive return rather than requiring 64
uses the potentially unreceived declared-total field at header offset 0x38 and allocates exactly that value
copies all 64 header bytes into that allocation before testing whether declared total size is at most 64
for declared totals above 64, receives declared_total-64 body bytes but accepts any positive short body before dispatch
dispatches the allocation to handleClientCmd for both the at-most-64 branch and the positive-body branch

local_command_dispatch.conclusion: the accepted local-client transaction dispatcher directly reaches all 11 iAp2MarshalGetBytes caller functions and both identification handlers that supply the heap-string wrapper; command and session-state predicates still apply

local_endpoint.accept_boundary: the exact accept-to-header-recv path performs no peer-credential check; no live pathname metadata or accepted peer was observed
local_endpoint.dac_creation_mode: 0777 before parent-directory, mount, and LSM checks
local_endpoint.server_creation: iAP2Service-2.0 calls umask(0), unlinks the path, creates and binds the pathname socket, restores the prior umask, and listens with backlog 5

smack.new_inode_label_semantics: Linux 4.1 Smack initializes a new inode from the creating task label unless transmutation applies
smack.runtime_boundary: actual task/socket/inode labels, /tmp mount label/transmutation state, live policy load, pathname ownership, and connect success remain unobserved

producer_inventory.boundary: the nine dynamic producers retain unchecked uint32 capacity arithmetic; upstream practical length ceilings, allocation feasibility, and alternate indirect producers are not established
